      • onBlockRegistered

        public void onBlockRegistered(org.bukkit.Location location,
                              boolean isPlacing)
        Description copied from class: BaseSTBBlock
        Called when an STB block has been registered with the location manager after being placed. The physical block has not necessarily been drawn in the world at this point, but BaseSTBBlock.getLocation() will return the block's location.
        Overrides:
        onBlockRegistered in class BaseSTBMachine
        Parameters:
        location - the location where the block has been registered
        isPlacing - if true, this is being called because the block is being placed by a player; if false, because the block is being restored from persisted data
